archetype.reason: Highest eligible deterministic fit; ties use configured priority
archetype.position_guidance: 장기 보유가 기본이다. 밸류에이션 과열 시 매도보다 추가매수 속도를 조절한다.

items.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손

assessments.rationale: FY2025 internal controls were effective and no fraud, material restatement or integrity breach is identified in the cutoff materials.
Current operations and capex are strongly supported by internal cash generation.
Dilution is limited and share count growth is modest; financing is primarily cash/debt rather than repeated equity issuance.
Diluted share count increased only modestly from 2023 to 2025 while FCF/share rose materially.
Demand is supported by firm backlog, mission-critical uptime economics and paid infrastructure deployment rather than subsidies.
Demand is backed by paid backlog, rapidly growing sales and mission-critical infrastructure needs.
Multi-year operating profit and FCF/share expansion provide direct evidence of improving incremental returns rather than collapse.
Backlog, service scale, margin expansion and portfolio breadth indicate a strengthening rather than shrinking competitive position as of the cutoff.

items.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구

assessments.rationale: Current price is near Base and well below Bull.
The cutoff price is near Base and materially below the locked Bull DCF, so Bull+ assumptions are not required.

items.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성

assessments.rationale: Revenue spans power, thermal, racks and services across three global regions; customer concentration remains a monitoring risk but no single disclosed dependency is fatal.

items.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음

assessments.rationale: Balance-sheet liquidity and cash generation make insolvency risk low; valuation/cycle risk remains but is not disproportionate to upside.
Liquidity, cash generation and debt service capacity are strong.
